chassis.note: box bottom sits on the twist-lock housings at deckY; a 20 ft box on the front pins has its centre 3.0675 m ahead of the model origin

provenance.fact: twist-lock housings at the ISO 1161 casting centres: 11.985 m x 2.259 m for a 40 ft box, 5.853 m for a 20 ft box
deck height 1.3 m, tyre radius 0.5 m, tri-axle trailer group, 3.7 m tractor wheelbase
provenance.reason: typical European 40 ft skeletal chassis and 4x2 tractor; engine TRUCK_DECK_M = 1.3

provenance.fact: gooseneck chassis with a kingpin 1.1 m behind the front pins
rigid tyre tread lugs and rim details are low-poly
cab-over cab shapes (high sleeper, mid sleeper, day cab) with maker wordmarks
provenance.source: public photographs of Volvo, Scania, DAF, MAN and Mercedes-Benz tractors (not committed)

provenance.fact: steering to 35 degrees, articulation up to 40 degrees
